local_articles.title: Brazil downgrades diplomatic ties with Argentina after Milei insults Lula
local_articles.snippet: BRASILIA, Aug 4 - Brazil has told Argentina its relations will be handled at the chargé d'affaires level after Argentine President Javier Milei again insulted Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, a Brazilian government source said on Tuesday. Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, will not return to Buenos Aires, the source said, after Milei referred to Lula in an interview with Argentine TV channel LN+ as an "ex-convict," a "thief" and "corrupt." The move formalizes a sharp deterioration in ties between two of Latin America's largest economies, whose presidents have not held an official bilateral meeting since Milei took office. questions.title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements by national nuclear operators or governments, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. An announcement initiating the shutdown of the last operating reactor qualifies; a partial shutdown alone does not. Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: Important 2026-08-04 Reuters update (19:58 IST) shifts the Hungary-Romania nuclear shutdown race to essentially a dead heat slightly favoring Romania: (1) Hungary trims 0.55 -> 0.46 after PM Peter Magyar reported that Paks survived being a few millimeters from total shutdown at 1:30 a.m. Tuesday when the Danube stopped falling and rose 1.5 cm by morning, with the sole operating turbine running safely, >300 firms easing grid demand, and Magyar flagging 'a potentially significant amount of rain' in Austrian Danube catchment areas around Thursday Aug 6 (which reaches Hungary within ~2-3 days, though Magyar cautioned it is uncertain to reach the Danube and Paks' 1.5 cm margin remains razor-thin). (2) Romania lifts 0.38 -> 0.47: Romania is still building its temporary dike by sinking four rock-filled barges (due to finish Wednesday or Thursday), and Nuclearelectrica executive Romeo Urjan told Digi24 that clearing the rock obstruction only extends the lone operating Cernavoda reactor by about seven days — placing potential exhaustion around Aug 10-11, squarely inside the Aug 1-13 window — while downstream Cernavoda (~1,200 km below Paks) is much less likely to receive timely relief from Thursday's Austrian rain. Holding Bulgaria (0.04), Slovenia (0.015), and Switzerland (0.005) (sum 0.99).

questions.current_reasoning: On July 14-15, 2026, National Assembly President Jorge Rodriguez and 2015-2020 opposition legislature representative Dinorah Figuera formally announced a US-backed joint work plan starting August 1, 2026 (RNV, Orinoco Tribune, Fakta, ABC Color, The Front Page). Lifting Electoral branch from 0.58 to 0.64 (below 0.65 before formal agreement) while keeping Judicial branch at 0.22 as the main alternative amid Venezuela's July 24-27 ICC exit and justice disputes.

questions.title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
questions.background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Decisive July 24-31 satellite and maritime confirmation (Reuters/Straits Times/gCaptain July 31, The Insider/Greenpeace July 31, Semafor July 28, The Week July 24): after an initial blast off Mukalla, Yemen on June 8, the sanctioned shadow-fleet Suezmax tanker Caroline Bezengi (IMO 9224439) drifted northeast and ran aground on June 12 on rocks off Jazirat Al-Qibliyyah in Oman's Al Hallaniyat Islands — roughly 45 km off Oman's mainland Dhofar/Al Wusta coast and >350 km northeast (downwind/downcurrent) of Yemen. Reuters verified the grounded vessel's identity from deck structures and paint, Greenpeace assessed 3-40 sq km of ongoing crude slicks, and July 28 satellite imagery shows a dark slick near the breached hull with lighter oil patches already spreading north of Al-Qibliyyah directly toward Oman's mainland coastline during peak July-August Southwest Monsoon winds/currents; Oman's Environment Authority issued oil-spill response guidance July 29 after Muscat's July 23 removal ultimatum went unanswered. Moving Oman sharply up (0.42 -> 0.85, capped at 0.85 pending official mainland-contamination confirmation under criteria), slashing Yemen (0.40 -> 0.08, retaining small residual for any delayed claim tied to the June 8 Mukalla blast), and placing small Arabian Sea / Gulf of Oman tails on Pakistan (0.02), Iran (0.02), and India (0.01) (sum 0.98).
